mutations.name: chapter ends at the video end instead of the next chapter's start
kills: layoutChapters ends each chapter where the next one opens, and the last at the video's end

mutations.name: first chapter opens at its first beat instead of 0
kills: layoutChapters opens the first chapter at 0 when a page extra with no chapter plays first

mutations.name: a split chapter is not refused
kills: layoutChapters refuses a chapter whose beats play on either side of another chapter
